code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Count distinct HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION sensitive areas whose centroid is within 3000m of any GENERAL station
query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) AS health_general_3km
FROM sensitive_area sa
CROSS JOIN air_quality_station aqs
WHERE sa.category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
  AND aqs.station_type = 'GENERAL'
  AND ST_DWithin(
        ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
        aqs.coordinate::geography,
        3000
      )
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
health_general_3km = int(result['health_general_3km'].values[0])
print(f"Distinct HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION within 3000m of GENERAL stations: {health_general_3km}")
